baseline_models.focus_anchor: The prohibition, protected self, divine inviolability, and exception by right form one gate.
baseline_models.mechanism: Life is the protected default. Ending it requires a positively established, binding warrant; the exception is not an unregulated gap in the prohibition.

activation_trace.role: Literal life-ending supplies the prohibited act and keeps all later authority tied to an irreversible harm.
The life-bearing self identifies the protected object as a living person rather than an abstract interest.
Inviolable claim, compact, and dignity make the life a protected charge that may not be breached casually.
Binding obligation and entitlement make the exception a positive warrant that must actually obtain.

changed_reading.before: A broad ban on killing followed by a generic exception.
changed_reading.after: A protected-status rule whose narrow gate opens only when a binding right has been established.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The wrongful killing, constituted wali, granted sultan, anti-excess clause, and promised support operate as one remedial sequence.
baseline_models.mechanism: Wrongful death generates a claim for redress; God constitutes the nearest responsible representative as its office-holder and grants effective capacity, while the same sentence limits the remedy's instrument and extent. The office is delegated and fiduciary, not private sovereignty.

activation_trace.role: A grievance seeking redress turns the passive victimhood into an enforceable claim.
Constituting something in a state supplies the act that creates, rather than merely notices, the representative's authority.
Taking charge of an affair frames the wali as an office-holder responsible for the victim's case.
Granted capacity and jurisdiction supply the effective means of redress without making their holder the source of the right.
Crossing a limit places an internal ceiling on the granted capacity at the point of its exercise.
Vindication after wrong makes support the completion of redress, not permission to multiply the wrong.

changed_reading.before: The victim's heir receives power to retaliate.
changed_reading.after: Wrongful death creates a divinely constituted remedial office whose effective authority and limiting condition arrive together.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Sultan, wali, haqq, mazlum, and mansur permit a coexisting juridical reading alongside physical retaliation.
baseline_models.mechanism: Sultan can function as prevailing proof, the wali as the party with priority and standing, and support as vindication. On this reading the grant first secures an actionable claim; lethal retaliation remains a bounded possible remedy rather than the definition of the grant.

activation_trace.role: A compelling proof supplies a juridical sense of authority that can prevail without being identical to force.
Priority and entitlement supply the representative's standing to press the victim's claim.
A specific right held by its owner makes the dispute an enforceable claim rather than undirected vengeance.
The grievance and demand for equity provide the claim that the proof and standing serve.
Aid that makes a party prevail supplies institutional effectiveness to the claim.
Error and missing the intended target add a caution against misapplication, not only excessive quantity.

changed_reading.before: Sultan is coercive power and mansur is promised victory in retaliation.
changed_reading.after: Sultan may first be prevailing proof and legal standing, while mansur marks an effectively vindicated claimant whose lethal remedy is still restricted.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding family unit reverses ordinary power: the stronger adult must lower himself before dependent parents with gentleness and mercy. That relational grammar revises wali from kinship-based control into a caretaking office whose very proximity requires self-restraint.

activation_trace.role: Parenthood by birth supplies the close family relation in which power is disciplined rather than enlarged.
Lowering wing and voice supplies the bodily pattern by which a stronger party deliberately reduces its dominance.
Gentle pliancy without humiliation makes restraint an active ethical posture rather than incapacity.
Tender mercy supplies the governing affect for exercising power inside a vulnerable relation.
Charge-taking anchors the family pattern back in the wali's responsibility for the victim's affair.
The explicit limit converts the imported posture of self-lowering into a constraint on redress.

structural_cues: The family-care commands precede the homicide rule within the same sustained imperative sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies close kinship, deliberate lowering, gentleness, and mercy; I carry that relational posture forward into the wali's office. A live alternative is that the parent commands and homicide rule remain separate duties with no transfer of posture.

changed_reading.before: Kinship proximity chiefly explains why the wali receives authority.
changed_reading.after: Kinship proximity also burdens the wali with caretaking restraint: standing rises from relation, but dominance must bend down.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence gives a relative his due, forbids scattering resources, rejects both a bound and a wholly released hand, and names a determinate amount. These images turn the wali's sultan into an administered entitlement whose release must stop at its proper measure.

activation_trace.role: A holder-specific right supplies the distributive model for treating redress as an entitlement owed to someone.
Scattering wealth through excess supplies the failure mode of dissipating a granted resource beyond its purpose.
Extending and releasing the hand supplies a bodily model for unrestrained execution of capacity.
An amount reaching its proper limit supplies the scalar ceiling for a remedy.
Granted capacity is the resource whose administration the surrounding scale controls.
Crossing the limit explicitly binds the resource-control sequence to retaliatory action.

structural_cues: Rights-giving, anti-dissipation, the closed/open hand contrast, and apportionment form a continuous resource-control sequence before 17:33.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a due, waste, hand-release, and determinate amount; I infer that granted remedial capacity is administered like a bounded entitlement. The live alternative is that these are only economic controls and contribute no legal scale to homicide.

changed_reading.after: Administer a measured entitlement: neither immobilize the victim's claim nor release remedial power beyond its assigned amount.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding killing rule exposes a concrete false warrant: anticipated deprivation. Fear projects a shortage, but apportioned provision removes that projection from human authorization and the killing is named as sin. Thus utility, fear, or resource prediction cannot self-issue the haqq exception.

activation_trace.role: The same literal life-ending root makes the neighboring case a direct test of what cannot qualify as warranted killing.
Fear with apprehension supplies the anticipatory motive that tries to authorize irreversible action.
A hand stripped of wealth supplies the imagined scarcity on which the killing calculation rests.
Apportioned provision removes control of the feared future from the killer's private forecast.
Sin and culpable wrong classify the fear-based killing as outside the legitimate gate.
The binding-warrant branch anchors the exclusion back to the focus exception.

structural_cues: The adjacent verse repeats the killing root before 17:33 and supplies motive, divine counterclaim, and moral verdict in one causal chain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fear of poverty, killing, apportioned provision, and culpability; I treat that chain as a counterexample to the focus's haqq. A live alternative limits the exclusion to child-killing without generalizing its motive test.

changed_reading.before: The exception by right is left formally open.
changed_reading.after: At least one proposed warrant is expressly closed: projected scarcity and protective utility cannot manufacture a right to kill.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus is bracketed by no-approach constructions protecting sexuality and orphan property, with the latter permitting only the best mode of engagement. This spatial grammar activates inviolability as a perimeter: protected life is guarded not only at the final act but along approaches that can culminate in unlawful killing.

activation_trace.role: Approaching and becoming entangled with a prohibited object supplies the near-side boundary before consummated harm.
The repeated approach boundary shows that controlled access can protect an interest before it is actually consumed.
Separation from a caregiver supplies the vulnerability that makes a protective perimeter necessary.
Beneficent action supplies the tightly qualified mode in which crossing a protective perimeter may serve its ward.
A sanctuary and its surrounding rights anchor the contextual approach-boundaries back to the inviolable life.
Literal killing remains the terminal harm whose upstream approaches the perimeter reading seeks to block.

structural_cues: Two no-approach constructions stand immediately on either side of the focus ayah, and the later one contains a controlled-access exception.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies flanking approach prohibitions and a sanctuary branch for inviolability; I infer an upstream protective buffer around life. A live alternative treats the parallel as rhetorical arrangement without extending the homicide rule beyond the completed act.

changed_reading.before: The rule prohibits the terminal act of unlawful killing.
changed_reading.after: Inviolable life also carries a protective perimeter around approaches and processes likely to end in unlawful killing.

context_deltas.mechanism: Full measure, just weighing, and straightness introduce an external standard for quantity. Applied to redress, the remedy must be commensurate and publicly measurable; the blood-measuring branch sharply resists arithmetic that treats additional lives as exchangeable compensation.

activation_trace.role: Completion without deficiency supplies the demand that the victim's claim be honored rather than erased.
The warning against measuring by blood directly challenges retaliatory arithmetic that converts one loss into further exchangeable lives.
The balance of justice supplies an external proportionality test for the remedy.
The scale supplies an inspectable instrument rather than a claimant's unreviewed feeling of sufficiency.
Straightness and equilibrium specify the quality the remedial measure must retain.
The focus's limit-crossing prohibition is the legal quantity disciplined by the surrounding scale.

structural_cues: The measurement command follows the bounded killing rule immediately, moving from an asserted limit to visible instruments of limit-keeping.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies full commercial measure, a just scale, straightness, and a blood-measuring branch; I transfer their quantity-control mechanism to redress. A live alternative keeps 17:35 wholly transactional and reads the sequence as a list rather than a procedural analogy.

changed_reading.before: Excess in killing is a morally understood but unspecified ceiling.
changed_reading.after: Redress belongs on a straight, reviewable scale: honor the claim fully, but do not turn blood into arithmetic for multiplying deaths.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ban on following without knowledge and the accountability of hearing, sight, and inward judgment provide an evidentiary process. Sultan as prevailing proof becomes primary, while killing's branch of exhaustive knowledge adds an exploratory demand for epistemic closure before an irreversible remedy.

activation_trace.role: Following a trace supplies the investigative motion that must not outrun what is actually known.
Disclosure of a fact to the knower supplies the threshold between evidence and conjecture.
Auditory perception supplies one evidence channel whose use will itself be answerable.
Discernment by the heart supplies evaluative judgment rather than mere sensory receipt.
The inwardly kindled heart supplies the motive-forming faculty that is also placed under review.
Compelling proof anchors the contextual evidence channels in the focus's grant of sultan.
Exhaustive knowledge of a matter creates an exploratory lexical bridge between irreversible killing and the need for epistemic closure.

structural_cues: The evidentiary command follows the balance command, yielding a measure-then-proof sequence after the focus rule.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies trace-following, absent knowledge, accountable perception, and branches for proof and exhaustive knowledge; I infer a due-process arrow before lethal redress. A live alternative reads 17:36 as a general epistemic ethic with no specific legal procedure for 17:33.

changed_reading.before: The wali's authority is chiefly capacity to execute a bounded remedy.
changed_reading.after: The wali's authority is first evidence-governed standing: perception, inference, and inward motive must withstand accountability before irreversible force.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing movement denies overbearing self-enlargement, exposes bodily inability to exceed the earth and mountains, and names wisdom as restraint for repair. These cues place the wali's granted sultan under a higher source: delegated effectiveness must never become self-authorizing sovereignty.

activation_trace.role: Joy that exceeds its measure supplies the affective shape of a power-holder enlarged by his own grant.
Abandoning gentleness and estimation supplies the practical failure of force that mistakes vehemence for reach.
Self-exaltation supplies the vertical image of delegated power pretending to be absolute.
Restraint that turns action back toward repair supplies the governing brake named as wisdom.
Constitution by another keeps the office-holder from becoming the source of his own authority.
The divine source of command and worship fixes the vertical limit above the granted sultan.
Delegated jurisdiction is the real but subordinate power corrected by the closing sequence.

structural_cues: Bodily limits precede the gathering of the commands as wisdom and the final denial of a second deity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies overreaching affect, failed physical reach, corrective restraint, and a divinely constituted grant; I infer that the closing hierarchy governs the wali's power. A live alternative treats the humility and monotheism clauses as broad closure rather than a specific theory of delegated authority.

changed_reading.before: God grants the wali enough power to obtain redress.
changed_reading.after: Because the power is granted, it remains subordinate: the wali may be effective but can never become self-authorizing or absolute.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the cited q-t-l branch concerns weakening drink with water, not homicide. It remains anchored in the focus's three literal q-t-l forms, its explicit anti-excess clause, and the surrounding hand-and-measure sequence. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for de-intensification, never as a replacement translation of killing.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The repeated killing root and the command not to exceed in killing permit a branch-distant image of reducing retaliatory intensity before action.

activation_trace.role: Breaking a drink's harshness by mixture supplies the material image of deliberately reducing retaliatory intensity.
The prohibition on passing the limit anchors de-intensification in the focus rather than in the drink image alone.
The fully released hand supplies the untempered state that the analogy seeks to interrupt.
Fitting an act to its amount and middle limit supplies the target state after tempering.

changed_reading.before: Restraint begins by counting how much retaliation occurs.
changed_reading.after: Restraint can begin earlier by cooling and diluting retaliatory intensity so the granted power does not harden into another killing impulse.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the cited s-l-t branch denotes lamp oil, not the ordinary sense of sultan in the focus. It remains anchored in the same root's compelling-proof branch and in the next verse's accountable knowledge and sight. Downstream prose should qualify it as an illuminating image for authority's fact-finding function, not as a lexical gloss for sultan.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The sultan grant can carry an exploratory image of authority making the case visible before it makes force available.

activation_trace.role: Oil used for light supplies the image of authority as a medium that reveals rather than merely overpowers.
Compelling proof keeps the illumination image connected to a live juridical sense of the focus word.
A fact becoming disclosed to a knower supplies what the illuminating authority must produce.
Actual sight supplies the accountable reception of what has been made visible.

changed_reading.before: Sultan equips the claimant to prevail over an opponent.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, sultan first lights the case: legitimate authority should expose facts clearly before it authorizes coercion.

strongest_changes: The wali's sultan becomes a measured, relational, and evidence-governed office rather than private revenge capacity.
The adjacent scarcity killing excludes fear-based utility from haqq, while the scale and knowledge commands supply proportionality and proof controls.
The two flanking no-approach constructions activate a protective perimeter around inviolable life.
summary.what_was_special: The sequence from resource restraint through child-killing, protected approaches, exact measure, accountable knowledge, and humbled power allowed legal, epistemic, spatial, and material readings to coexist without displacing the literal homicide rule.
remaining_uncertainties: The final pronoun may point to the wali or the wrongfully slain, which changes whether support names an office-holder's aid or the victim's secured vindication.
The commercial scale and epistemic-accountability commands may supply direct procedural controls or only strong analogies.
The sanctuary-perimeter and material-tempering readings are branch-valid but should remain explicitly exploratory.
